items.t: Strategy Is Worth Less Than Its Bitcoin, Trump Media May Have To Sell
items.sum: Both Strategy and Trump Media may have convertible bond regrets.

items.t: Trump Media Gains 3% Despite Market Wobble and Looming $883.5 Million Note Deadline; Rumble Falls 3%
items.sum: Trump Media is bouncing while the market slips, but a November 30 deadline could force a tough choice over cash, credit, and a huge Bitcoin stash. Who decides how much the company owes, and can it avoid giving something up?

items.t: Trump Media Climbs 3% After Buying Back $100 Million in Convertible Notes; Rumble Slides 3%, Meta Dips
items.sum: Trump Media just retired a slice of its debt for less than it owed, yet the stock remains deeply underwater and a billion-dollar bill still looms. Can one cash-funded move calm the pressure before a merger vote reshuffles everything?

items.t: As Bitcoin Plummets, Trump Media Warns It May Have To Sell Some To Repay Noteholders. Here’s Why Nov. 30 Is The Key Date For Its $1 Billion In Notes
items.sum: Trump Media borrowed against its bitcoin stash, and now lenders hold a one-time option to demand cash. With coins sliding, thousands of them recently on the move, and a shareholder vote looming, the company's repayment plan faces a real test.
